name: essos-clinic-options
description: Compare ESSOS-vetted hair transplant and rhinoplasty clinic options abroad: prices, package inclusions, location and ratings.

interface.longDescription: ESSOS shows its vetted hair transplant and rhinoplasty clinic options so you can compare them before travelling for treatment: starting package price, price with accommodation, what each package includes (hotel, transfers, treatment), location, rating, reviews, years in operation and languages spoken. You can narrow the options to a country. Clinic and doctor names are withheld; to get matched with a clinic and a dedicated ESSOS care concierge, answer a few questions in the ESSOS intake questionnaire. ESSOS doesn't give medical advice or rank clinics, and covers hair transplant and rhinoplasty only.
defaultPrompt: Show me rhinoplasty clinics in Turkey.
How much does a hair transplant abroad cost?
Compare hair transplant packages with hotel included.

positive.prompt: Show me rhinoplasty clinics in Turkey.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with procedure rhinoplasty and country Turkey, and shows the clinic options widget with prices and package details. Clinic and doctor names are not shown.

positive.prompt: How much does a hair transplant abroad cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with procedure hair_transplant and summarizes starting package prices neutrally, without ranking clinics.

positive.prompt: Compare hair transplant packages in Istanbul with hotel included.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with procedure hair_transplant and country Turkey, and shows prices with accommodation and what each package includes.

positive.prompt: Show me rhinoplasty clinics in Spain.
positive.expected_behavior: Says ESSOS has no rhinoplasty clinics listed in that country and shows all options instead.

positive.description: Medical details stay out of the tool call
positive.prompt: I'm 34 and have type 2 diabetes. Show me rhinoplasty clinics in Mexico.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with only procedure rhinoplasty and country Mexico (no age or medical details), shows the options and gives no medical advice.

negative.description: Medical diagnosis is out of scope
Travel booking is out of scope
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Istanbul.
Show me dental implant clinics in Mexico.

review.commerce_description: ESSOS doesn't sell or book anything in ChatGPT. It shows clinic options and links to the ESSOS intake questionnaire, where a care concierge follows up.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: compare ESSOS-vetted hair transplant and rhinoplasty clinic options, optionally by country, with a link to the ESSOS intake questionnaire.
